scope: 2F static Android schema 7 anchor sessions. This is signal separability inspection, not walking-position accuracy or Fusion output.

wifi_fresh_scan_within_session.method: For zones with two fresh Wi-Fi scans, classify each scan using the other scan as its same-zone reference and every available 2F zone as a competing reference. Require at least two shared APs and compare median absolute RSSI error.
wifi_fresh_scan_within_session.limitation: The two scans in each pair came from one stationary session, so this measures immediate repeatability rather than a different-time walking test. Zones with one fresh scan were not evaluated.

ble_half_window.method: Split each stationary BLE observation sequence into first and latter halves. Classify each half against the opposite-half reference for every zone using median absolute RSSI error.
ble_half_window.limitation: Halves are from the same stationary session. The result is optimistic and cannot establish real walking accuracy.

interpretation: The current signal strengths have enough provisional difference for coarse zone/portal confirmation, especially when PDR already narrows the candidate corridor. They do not yet support exact free-space coordinates or signal-only entry decisions between study_entry_main and study_inside.
